name: Tidewrought Coast
description: Rugged ocean coastline of misty sea-cliffs, tidal flats, flooded pre-flood ruins, and abyssal sea trenches.

sluice_flow.name: The Sluice Lock Mechanism
sluice_flow.hint: Open the sea-surge valve (1), close the mud-gate (2), then engage the lower weir drain (3) to drain the sunken harbor pathway.

sunken_path.name: The Drowned Causeway
sunken_path.hint: The churning coastal deep will submerge ordinary travelers, but Kaelen's Magic Eye [V] reveals the ancient submerged coral causeway.

tidal_reflection.name: The Tidal Pearl Mirrors
tidal_reflection.hint: Rotate the three pearl reflection mirrors until the coastal light beams converge upon the Abyssal Vault Gate.

q_tide_arrival.title: Tides of Thalassport
q_tide_arrival.description: Report to Captain Marina at the Thalassport Quarterdeck and consult Sea-Seer Vael near the tide pools.

objectives.text: Speak with Captain Marina at the Thalassport Quarterdeck
Consult Sea-Seer Vael by the sacred tide pools

q_tide_sluice.title: The Draining of the Flats
q_tide_sluice.description: Deliver the relic fragment to Scholar Sylas and solve the harbor sluice gate puzzle to uncover the flooded causeway.

objectives.text: Deliver Coral Astrolabe to Scholar Sylas
Operate the Harbor Sluice Valves to lower the water

q_abyssal_beasts.title: Voices of the Deep
q_abyssal_beasts.description: Journey to Whale Song Shoals to commune with the Sacred Abyssal Whale, and brave Serpent's Trench to receive the Great Serpent's blessing.

objectives.text: Commune with the Sacred Whale at Whale Song Shoals
Receive the serpent scale at Serpent's Trench

q_smuggler_choice.title: The Smuggler's Bargain
q_smuggler_choice.description: Corvo offers a stolen pearl prism that opens the temple vault, but asks you to hide his contraband cache from Captain Marina. A hard moral choice awaits.

objectives.text: Decide whether to aid Corvo or report his syndicate to Captain Marina

q_sunken_depths.title: The Drowned Causeway
q_sunken_depths.description: Cross the treacherous flooded tidal chasm. Activate Kaelen's Magic Eye [V] to reveal the submerged coral pathway.

objectives.text: Traverse the Drowned Causeway using Eye Vision

q_reflection_altar.title: The Mirror of Tides
q_reflection_altar.description: Rotate the three Tidal Pearl Mirrors on the sea cliffs to direct lunar reflections into the Abyssal Vault Gate.

objectives.text: Rotate the 3 Pearl Mirrors to focus water reflections onto the Gate
Insert the Luminescent Tidal Pearl to unseal the Sanctuary

q_deep_mind_verdict.title: The Deep Mind's Verdict
q_deep_mind_verdict.description: Descend into the Sunken Sanctuary, face the sea god Nerivael, and claim the Water Elemental Stone.

objectives.text: Witness the divine manifestation of Nerivael
Claim the Stone of Abyssal Depth
